answer.reason: The verses tell what was done with the cross and what happened on it: it was carried to Golgotha, Jesus was crucified there, and Pilate's title was set on it.

clauses.english: was carried by Jesus to Golgotha
clauses.quote: he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull

clauses.english: was where Jesus was crucified, with two others on either side
clauses.quote: Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one

clauses.english: had Pilate's title, JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS, put on it
clauses.quote: Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross.

doubts: JHN 19:18 says where Jesus was crucified without using the word cross; the link comes from verse 17.
Simon of Cyrene being made to bear the cross (MAT 27:32, MRK 15:21, LUK 23:26) was left out to keep the line short.
Verses where passers-by and priests say 'come down from the cross' are taunts, not events of the cross, so they were not used.
